title: Grateful Dead Live at Wembley Empire Pool on 1972-04-07
lineage: AUD > mac (2 sources) > cass > cdr + M? > low-gen reel > CDR > ??? > wav > SHN > wav > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Muddy audience recording that’s almost unlistenable, but the second‑set Truckin' and The Other One provide rare musical highlights.
ai_review.review: The audio source is a very poor audience capture – listeners describe it as muddy, “tennis match of sounds,” and virtually unlistenable. Musically the show has a few bright spots, notably an excellent Truckin' with a strong Garcia solo and a superb The Other One (with a Me & My Uncle jam), while the first set is largely unremarkable and songs like Boss Man and Casey Jones are deemed terrible.

ai_rating.rationale: All seven reviews rate the release between 0‑2 stars, uniformly condemning the recording quality; musical performance gets a few positive notes but cannot outweigh the severe audio issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Both audience sources are described as extremely muddy, unlistenable and full of drop‑outs; reviewers call it a “tennis match of sounds” and advise waiting for a better source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is largely unremarkable; second set shines with a strong Truckin' and an expansive The Other One, though overall the performance suffers from the poor acoustic environment.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s solo on Truckin' praised as very nice; interplay with Keith noted during The Other One.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's interplay with Jerry during The Other One highlighted as superb.
